ValidationRule.description: When a Case's Project is "Account Tier Change" with Subject "Account Tier Change - AGP to Starter" and a user is trying to close it, they must fill out the Results field with notes.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
/*If Case Project is 'Account Tier Change' and Status is changed to Closed, Results must not be blank*/
AND( ISPICKVAL(Project__c , 'Account Tier Change'), Subject = 'Account Tier Change - AGP to Starter', ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Closed'), ISCHANGED(Status), ISBLANK( Results__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before closing this case you must enter notes about the Account's tier movement in the Results field. You must also make sure you have updated the relevant account information in Pro (e.g. promos, pricing, services, classification)!
